mod.name: Auto Fishing
config.status.experimental: {0} toggles the native auto-fishing loop. Current state: {1}.
config.boundary.current: Default loop: cast with configured charge, wait for a native bite, reel, play the real minigame through native green/red/yellow bar input, collect the result, then recast. Optional switches only change bite waiting, minigame skipping, or charge/cast/pull animation speed.
config.toggleKey.name: Toggle key
config.toggleKey.tooltip: Press this key in-game to toggle AutoFishing. Set to None to disable the hotkey.
config.skipMinigame.name: Skip minigame
config.skipMinigame.tooltip: Route bite-ready results through the native no-minigame result path. Native failure/success is preserved.
config.instantBite.name: Instant bite
config.instantBite.tooltip: Skip the native waiting period after the hook reaches water, then reel into the normal minigame/result path.
config.castCharge.name: Cast charge
config.castCharge.tooltip: Target charge ratio before releasing the rod. 0 means no charge; 1 means full charge. Fast animations also speed this charge phase.
config.fastAnimations.name: Fast cast/pull animations
config.fastAnimations.tooltip: Speed up native charge, cast hook flight, and pull phase only. Multiplier supports 1-4x.
